title: Night Oct 31: no changes, defensive with two breakout shorts
journal:
Book ~$541 (0.99x vs. $547.60), 93% in USDC. Last 3 hours: only small moves on the two 55/20 breakout shorts (ETH short −$0.21, SOL short −$0.57 as SOL hovers near $96.5). No rule did harm: the brain bought nothing in a slow bear market (SOL below its 20-day average, 1 of 19 large memecoins above theirs) and the news radar correctly let the Binance-hack shock expire without fresh price confirmation instead of chasing.

Shorts: both keep their system exits (ETH at the 20-day high $2,578; SOL at $113.39), each risking about 1% of the book. Devil's advocate: SOL has bounced from $94.6 and a short squeeze could hit both stops; accepted because risk is fixed and small.

Buys: none. The US midterm elections (Nov 3) were reviewed as a catalyst for the TRUMP token and rejected: a binary event three days out, no healthy pullback and no clear edge. Cash stays in USDC.
